exposure: very preterm delivery (28 + 0/7 to 31 + 6/7 weeks of gestation)
Women with GDM delivering very preterm vs. women without GDM delivering very preterm
outcome: Neonatal morbidity (bronchopulmonary dysplasia, prematurity retinopathy, neonatal anemia)
cohort: 30 women delivering very preterm (28 + 0/7 to 31 + 6/7 weeks of gestation)
finding: Very preterm delivery in women with GDM does not confer an increased risk for neonatal complications compared to women without GDM delivering at the same gestational age.
mod_finding: All women in the study had a cesarean delivery.
